newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Tamil Tiger rebels stage abortive attack on Talaimannar navy base, taking cover behind India fishing boats on Monday night.
Police arrest doctor who worked for Tamil Tiger rebels in north and also served as family doctor of rebel chief Velupillai Prabhakaran.
Army kills 15 Tamil rebels in eastern Valachchenai after loss of 12 soldiers in Monday's ambush.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga urges newly-elected local bodies to provide greater service to the people.
Norwegian diplomat accused of taking bribes from Sri Lankan Tamil asylum seekers.
Air force says one of four An-23 transport planes damaged during forced landing because of bad weather.
